name: Stale content refresh
description: Find the oldest still-relevant published posts, refresh facts and dates where safe, and leave an audit trail via a checkpoint before writing.

steps.title: Safety checkpoint
steps.detail: Call wp_create_checkpoint with a label like 'content-refresh pre-flight' so every change made by this run is revertible in one call.

steps.title: Pick the candidates
steps.detail: Call wp_list_posts (status=publish, orderby=date asc, per_page=<count>) and read each with wp_get_post. Flag posts whose content references years, prices or 'coming soon' blocks.

steps.title: Check current SEO meta
steps.detail: Call wp_get_post_seo for each candidate to see the live title/description before touching anything.

steps.title: Refresh the copy
steps.detail: Call wp_update_post per approved candidate: update stale references, fix broken internal references you can verify, keep the author's voice. Draft the diff summary for the owner.

steps.title: Report and offer rollback
steps.detail: Summarize what changed per post id and remind the owner the checkpoint from step 1 reverts everything with wp_restore_checkpoint.

guardrails: One post at a time: update, verify with wp_get_post, then move on.
Never delete content during a refresh; suggest deletion separately.
Stop and ask when a fact cannot be verified from the site itself.
